title: Every simulator boot goes through the lock and is recorded
why: After PR #1022 (lane sim-machine-lock, Nov 1 20:43 CST), two holes remain: some boots skip the lock, and sim-test boots go unrecorded.
note: (1) xcodebuild -destination naming a shut-down device, and the MCP launch tool, still boot outside the sim-test lock; route or refuse them. (2) sim-test boots are no longer checked by sim-boot-is-verified and write no sim-boots.jsonl line, so a sim-test killed with SIGKILL leaves an unrecorded simulator that the sweep keeps; sim-test records its boot. Red first for each. Other gaps: docs/debts/notes.md (lane sim-machine-lock). Port: yes. Ready after PR #1022 merges.
